recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the remaining current-source wording gap from the published FHIR-17995 rename and remains consistent with later patient-payment scope.
issue_request: FHIR-17995 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and requested changing PaymentReconciliation.organization to an issuer element, resolved as changing .organization to paymentIssuer.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged GF#17995 commit f369c813fb renamed the PaymentReconciliation example and spreadsheet source from organization to paymentIssuer. Current source retained the PaymentReconciliation.paymentIssuer element, example usage, and fhir.ini compatibility alias from PaymentReconciliation.organization to PaymentReconciliation.paymentIssuer, but the active payment-issuer SearchParameter still described the target as an organization.
additional_context: PaymentReconciliation is active in source/fhir.ini, and the search parameter bundle is current source for built resource search parameters. Later FHIR-26601 expanded PaymentReconciliation to patient-payment scenarios, and current paymentIssuer targets Organization, Patient, and RelatedPerson, making the old organization-only search description too narrow. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting FHIR-17995 discussion.
reconciliation: Changed source/paymentreconciliation/bundle-PaymentReconciliation-search-params.xml so PaymentReconciliation-payment-issuer says 'The party which generated the payment' while preserving the code and expression PaymentReconciliation.paymentIssuer.
source_changes: source/paymentreconciliation/bundle-PaymentReconciliation-search-params.xml: changed PaymentReconciliation-payment-issuer description from 'The organization which generated this resource' to 'The party which generated the payment'.

related_jiras.note: Expanded PaymentReconciliation to patient-payment scenarios, reinforcing that current paymentIssuer wording must not be organization-only.
